metadata.name: perf-scroll-shell
metadata.description: Perf-capture flow (intent:performance). Assertion-free: waits for the app shell to mount, then scrolls the main content region so performance-health can trace the scroll interaction inside the perf-trace window. Never bind as a requirement automation case — it must stay out of the functional Playbooks suite. Capture: performance-health audit run react-component-library --workflow perf-scroll-shell.
